content_units: Working window used for ranking:   09:00-18:00 local time   for each participant.
A 45-minute kickoff is most convenient when it stays fully inside working hours and avoids very early/late edges.
Rank   UTC Start   New York   Berlin   Singapore   Convenience
1     13:00       09:00       14:00       21:00     Best overall balance; NY starts right at workday start, Berlin is ideal, Singapore is late but not the latest option
2     12:00       08:00       13:00       20:00     Slightly early for NY, but better for Singapore than later slots
3     14:00       10:00       15:00       22:00     Good for NY/Berlin, quite late for Singapore
4     15:00       11:00       16:00       23:00     Strong for NY/Berlin, very inconvenient for Singapore
5     16:00       12:00       17:00       00:00 (Mar 19)     Worst for Singapore; crosses into midnight
- Best pick if you want the strongest overall compromise across all three locations.
- Best alternative if reducing Singapore lateness matters more than keeping New York strictly within work hours.
- There is   no candidate time fully inside working hours for all three cities  .
-   Berlin   is comfortable for all listed options.
- For a kickoff meeting,   13:00 UTC   is the cleanest compromise.
- If Singapore’s comfort should be prioritized slightly more, choose   12:00 UTC  .
- just outside work hours = acceptable but less convenient
- very late evening / near midnight = poor
